name: conditional-future-credit-v1
objective: state-span-huber-v1: delta[a]=double(loss[HOLD])-loss[a]; scale=max(max_abs_finite_delta,1e-6*(abs(double(loss[HOLD]))+1)); target[a]=delta[a]/scale. HOLD target=0; nonfinite alternatives target=-1; nonfinite HOLD refused. Mean three-head Huber delta=1, simultaneous update from pre-fit weights.
replay_order: ascending seed, then ascending checkpoint; identical order each epoch; all three heads fitted together

development_selection.data: only archived seeds42/73, eight common states per body

archive_reuse: Authenticate all309 archived identities plus results.json before copying corpora, token streams,16 development source lives and sealed initial/relative-future lives. Recompute each sample from archived full diagnostic trace and verify source features in C before fitting.

common_state_controls.initial: Does measured future experience change choices at identical source history?
common_state_controls.oldfuture-simple: Same163network,512epochs and old loss-relative target: does state-span conditioning change decisions?
common_state_controls.oldfuture-adapted: Old objective after matched HeVLM adaptation.
common_state_controls.conditional-simple: Frozen SimpleLLM life transfers to independent new-seed SimpleLLM and HeVLM states.
common_state_controls.conditional-adapted: Does HeVLM adaptation alter its frozen parent's choices?
common_state_controls.source: Greedy original immediate-feedback life at the exact source history.
common_state_controls.brake: Constant BRAKE identifies conditionality versus a fixed cautious action.
common_state_controls.push: Constant PUSH identifies conditionality versus the prior learned result.

common_state_readout: Load exact source life, authenticate observation/features, graft only163 sealed weights into source history, exploration0, select through ordinary C API, pair chosen action with its executed common-state branch.

closed_loop.initialization: Each independent process initializes the same body/window/noise seeds. Learned arms copy only163 sealed weights into a freshly initialized host Architect with body seed and exploration0. History begins empty.
closed_loop.policy_history: Every selected action executes in the real training loop. Frozen feedback completes its actual same-window consequence and advances temporal history/counters; all163weights remain byte-identical throughout.
closed_loop.history_reward: clamp((before-after_same_window)/(abs(before)+1e-6),-1,1), the existing measured online observation; no online fitting
closed_loop.policy_continuation: Repeat conditional-adapted independently on each body/seed, save/reload its complete Architect at256, continue actual body in process, compare all step/evaluation rows and final body/moments/controls/policy bytes to uninterrupted execution.
primary_comparisons: conditional arms versus fixed hold/push and canonical Chuck
metrics: elapsed seconds and peakRSS per process

tie_rule: Exact recorded F32 loss equality; retain every tied minimum.
fit_state: Only weights change. Counters/history/RNG/v1 saved-life format remain intact. Conditioning objective and scale are explicit external receipts.
host_noninterference: Independent ordinary and diagnostic source hosts match every numerical step and final body/moments/controls/life bytes.
terminal_integrity: Reread full traces and all recorded hashes before final success. Complete step sequence, summaries, paired hosts, resume continuation and sealed weights must still match.

smoke.purpose: development-only wiring check; never use307/509 before sealed final run
